name: Kuraki Suzuna
source:
"You should just hurry up and get kicked out already!"

The only daughter of the Kuraki family.
She has inherited the role of the "Tsukimachi no Miko" (Moon-Waiting Priestess), passed down through generations. Raised with great care, she's a strong-willed young lady, but also somewhat naive about the world. She refuses to acknowledge Koichi as the new head of the family and often behaves in a rebellious and confrontational manner.

[From the [url=https://aridesign.co.jp/root/nsmr/character.html]official site[/url].]
